strategic_priorities.priority: Market Share Expansion to 15% National Retail Deposit Share
strategic_priorities.evidence: Chase has national market share in retail deposits of 11.3% as of end of 2024. Share of outstandings has grown on average about 90 basis points a year over the last five years and about 100 basis points in 2023 and 2024.
strategic_priorities.source: Chase 2025 Investor Day, The Financial Brand

strategic_priorities.priority: Small Business Primary Bank Market Leadership
strategic_priorities.evidence: The firm is gaining share as a primary bank, up nearly 30 basis points over the last five years. Maintains number one positions in both deposit share and primary bank for business. Added about 30 basis points of share a year over the last 10 years.

$18 billion technology budget in 2025 (up from $17B in 2024), with $1.3 billion dedicated to AI capabilities. Over 450 AI use cases in development. AI projected to deliver $1.5-2.0 billion in annual business value.
strategic_priorities.source: McKinsey Interview with Derek Waldron, CNBC, Constellation Research

strategic_priorities.evidence: Opening 500 new branches and renovating 1,700 existing locations over three years. Nearly 150 branches opened in 2024. Branch investments break even in less than four years.
strategic_priorities.source: The Financial Brand, JPMorgan Chase 2025 Investor Day

strategic_priorities.priority: Connected Commerce and Embedded Banking Growth
strategic_priorities.evidence: Connected commerce produced $20 billion in volume in 2023, with projections of $30 billion in 2025. Goal to turn Chase into a 'lifestyle brand' and trusted advisor to card members.
strategic_priorities.source: The Financial Brand, JPMorgan Chase 2024 Investor Day

recent_initiatives.details: Added digital invoicing solution exclusively for Business Complete Banking customers at no cost. Launched QuickAccept for instant card payment processing. Added Tap to Pay for iPhone. Planning to introduce Customer Insights, a business intelligence platform with aggregated data and marketing suggestions.

recent_initiatives.initiative: Largest Fraud Prevention Initiative in Firm History
recent_initiatives.details: Launched comprehensive fraud and scam prevention program after losing $500M to fraud in 2024 ($300M direct, $200M reimbursements). Successfully safeguarded customers from $12 billion in fraud and scam attempts. Includes operational enhancements, technology investments, and specialized staff training.
Rolled out new credit analysis tool powered by Artificial Intelligence to improve small business lending decisions and efficiency.

Now has embedded finance partnerships with more than 20 clients and expects that number to double over the next year. Targets healthcare, autos, e-commerce marketplaces. Notable partnership with Walmart for marketplace sellers.

£40 million five-year commitment to UK small businesses. Deployed over £10M in first year. Includes £4M to Responsible Finance for CDFIs, £1.2M to Newable for supply chain access for 15,000 underserved businesses, and Fintech Forward Programme support.

recent_initiatives.initiative: Madison Square Garden Small Business Partnership
recent_initiatives.details: Spotlight Series partnership providing NYC small businesses with prime concourse space at MSG events and $10,000 grants. 23 businesses featured since 2022-2023 NBA/NHL seasons.
New resource center providing educational content and advice to help early-stage and established entrepreneurs achieve their goals.
